title: Aurora Noir
summary: A deep blue-black research palette with cool mint accents and crisp scientific status colors.
details: Aurora Noir keeps the canvas quiet while giving active controls, references, and research states a restrained northern-light glow. It is designed for long evening sessions without flattening the hierarchy between conversation, evidence, and tools.
features: Low-glare blue-black surfaces for long research sessions
Mint focus and navigation accents without neon saturation
Clearly separated evidence, warning, success, and failure colors
